title: Sort without sort
prompt:
Write `SortInts(a []int)` that sorts `a` ascending in place without `sort`, `slices` or any other library sorting.

It must handle empty, sorted, reversed and duplicate-heavy input, and stay fast on a few thousand elements.

`[5 2 9 1 5]` → `[1 2 5 5 9]`
hint: Quicksort with a middle pivot, or merge sort if you want a guaranteed O(n log n).
